# One Trait to Rule Them All

**Version 2.5** · for Crusader Kings III 1.20.* · [Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2245233173) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [All versions](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=one-trait&expanded=true)

One menu and one panel. Twenty-one trait cheats, a Character Editor, a
Modern Systems menu with twenty-three more, and a wonder of its own.
Everything you have ever wanted to do to a Crusader Kings save, in one place.

---

## How it works

1. Right-click any character, including yourself, and choose **One Trait**;
  or click the round **One Trait** button beside your portrait.
1. **The One Trait panel**: every trait, Sanctum power and army power is a
  row you switch On or Off with one click, on whoever you opened it for, plus
  your puppets.
1. The menu holds the rest: **Family**, **Puppets**, **Summon**,
  **Titles**, **Diplomacy**, **Succession**, **Character Editor**,
  **Modern Systems** and **Buildings**. Right-click for
  **Give a title** and **Marry**.

## What is in the cabinet

**The character themselves**

- **Unlimited Wealth** — income and tax tripled, gold pouring in; and
  **Unlimited Fame** — prestige, renown, piety, legitimacy, influence, merit
- **Chosen of God** — perfect spiritual fulfillment, four personal tenets,
  piety that pays in every skill, and religion that costs nothing
- **Boosted Stats**, and **Supreme Learner** for pouring lifestyle
  experience
- **Unnatural Long Life** — immune to plague and disease, a century more
  of life — or full **Immortality**
- **Completely Loveable** — nobody can dislike you, and your legends spread
  like wildfire
- **Unlimited Dread** — everybody is terrified of you, and tyranny costs
  nothing
- **No Stress**, **Physical Giant**, and **Endless Fertility**
  (children with the good genes, never the inbreeding) or **Celibacy**

**Ruling and war**

- **Supreme Manager of the Realm** — control, development, climbing court
  grandeur, artifacts that never decay, free titles; and **Master Builder** —
  every building at once, for nothing
- **Supreme Domain** — hold as much land as you please
- **Supreme Commander** — unbeatable in battle, an army that costs nothing
  to raise or keep, free landings, safe roads
- **The Army of the One** — Legion, Bowmen and Riders, elite regiments
  you recruit free or raise from the menu — plus **Unlimited** and **Free Men at
  Arms**, **Unlimited** and **Extremely Effective Knights**
- **The Wars of the One** — five casus belli, free and needing no border:
  **Conquest** of any title at any tier, **Subjugation** of a whole realm,
  **Tribute**, **Ransom** for gold, hooks and prisoners, and a lightning
  **Blitz**
- **Ultimate Schemer** — your schemes, contracts and plots always succeed,
  instantly and unseen; agents always join; nobody's scheme against you can win
- **Family** — designate them your heir, adopt them into your house,
  disown them, bring them to your court; and **Marry** any of your family
  to any of theirs, matrilineally if you like
- **Diplomacy** — alliances made and broken at will, vassals and
  tributaries without a war, wars won outright, truces, hooks, friendships and adoration; and Hostility: strike
  them dead, imprison or free them, banish them, excommunicate them or lift it
- **Summon** — master councillors seated at once, a champion, a spouse
  candidate or a gifted ward, straight into your court
- **Puppet Master** — make any ruler your puppet, or any clergy your
  Clerical Ruler or Realm Priest Puppet, whatever your faith; then act through
  them from the game's own puppets row
- **Titles** — take anyone's primary title, every title or whole realm,
  destroy their primary title, claim all of it, or **Give a title** of yours
- **Succession** — any succession or gender law, your heir takes
  everything, authority up or down, coronation, and every title you qualify
  for, created at once

**Character Editor**

- **Identity**: swap culture and faith with the right-clicked character or
  take their capital's; reroll their name
- **Traits**: perfect genetics, a full cleanse of disease and injury,
  personality copied either way, every bad coping habit broken
- **Body**: age 16, 25, 40 or 60, and hereditary looks copied either way
- **Canonize** departed kin as saints

**Modern Systems** — for the things a trait toggle does not suit

- **The Character**: court grandeur, influence, merit and legitimacy (each
  with a drain), becoming a mythical legend, accolade glory, a relic
- **The Realm**: fill or drain the herd, upgrade the domicile, end the
  Iberian and Persian struggles, release every tributary, unleash a plague
- **Culture**: unlock a culture's innovations up to its era or of every
  era, and full acceptance between your culture and theirs
- **Government**: make any ruler Feudal, Clan, Tribal, Nomadic,
  Administrative, Ecclesiastical, a Republic, a Theocracy or a regional
  government; their holdings and vassals follow
- **Blessing of the Horde** for nomads — vast herds and pastures that
  never wear out — and **The Wanderer's Road** — fast, safe travel for anyone
  and a camp that never runs short for landless adventurers
- **Become a Conqueror**: starts the game's own conquest, with vassals
  offering armies and the conqueror's casus belli; or as the **Scourge of the
  Gods**. **End the conquest** stops it with no penalty.

**Buildings**

- **Construction**: max every building in the capital county, the domain
  or the whole realm; fill empty baronies; add building slots; max duchy
  buildings; finish great projects; rebuild ruins. Built from the game's own
  files, so every building, DLC ones included, is covered.
- **The Sanctum of the One**: a wonder only One Trait can raise. Its county
  cannot be taken, and on the panel it wakes eleven powers one by one — the
  realm builds itself, a golden age, one faith and one people, every secret and
  scheme laid bare, a hook on every vassal, no factions, a relic every year, a
  hall of champions, ever-full armies, and tribute from every ruler in the
  world. Each power reports in your message feed when it acts, and **Invoke
  every awakened power now** runs them all at once. It passes to your heir and
  never replaces a wonder already standing.

## Built for the game as it is now

First released in 2020, now wired into every system added since, from
influence, legitimacy and court grandeur to nomad herds, the landless camp and
By God Alone.

Every trait, regiment, war and building icon is original artwork made for
this mod.

## Things to know

- **Almost everything is reversible.** Traits can be removed, blessings
  revoked, the conquest ended, and resources drained. The few permanent options
  say so on the button.
- **The plague cannot be undone.** There is no cure in this game: once you
  unleash it on a capital, it stays.
- **Works on anyone**: rival, vassal or courtier.
- **The AI never uses any of it on its own.** Make a rival a Conqueror,
  though, and they will act like one.

## Compatibility

- Built and tested against **CK3 1.20 "Crozier"** and By God Alone.
- **Achievements** are disabled, which is rather the point.
- Adds its own traits, buildings, regiments, casus belli and puppet types, and
  overwrites no base game file.
- Safe to add mid-game. Remove the traits and disband any One Trait army
  before removing the mod.

## Languages

All nine game languages; the other eight show English text until translated.

## Install

- **Steam Workshop:** subscribe on the Workshop page above.
- **Manually, any version:** download `one-trait-v<version>.zip` from the [releases](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=one-trait&expanded=true) and extract it into `Documents/Paradox Interactive/Crusader Kings III/mod/`, then enable it in the launcher.
